education.degree: B.Tech Artificial Intelligence and Data Science

projects.description: Built an end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) application for intelligent document querying. Implemented semantic search using SentenceTransformers embeddings and FAISS vector indexing. Integrated Groq LLM with a Flask backend to generate context-aware responses with reduced hallucinations.

Built a text-to-image generation pipeline using Stable Diffusion (Dreamlike Diffusion, SDXL) with GPU-accelerated inference. Implemented prompt-based image synthesis using Hugging Face Diffusers and Transformers. Enabled image visualization, saving, and download using Matplotlib.

Built a cross-platform mobile app aggregating competition data with search and category filtering options. Built a cross-platform application for students and entrepreneurs to create, organize, and manage competitions, events, and hackathons.

Developed an Android app to solve handwritten mathematical expressions using AI models. Implemented real-time camera capture, preprocessing, and expression recognition for accurate solutions. Designed a student-friendly interface for quick input, solution display, and step-by-step guidance.
